title: He Hablado --- A Verb With No Meaning Left
label: ch:perfect-first-person
canDo: I can say he hablado, and say what haber contributes to it.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C49-he-hablado: produce he hablado espanol and say what haber means there.
payoff.note: Answers the question learners actually have: haber means nothing here. Spanish gave the meaning to tener, exactly as English hollowed out have.
